mapper.select: SELECT id, config_key, config_value::text AS config_value, config_name, is_status, remark, update_time FROM sys_config WHERE config_key = #{configKey} LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_config
AND config_key LIKE CONCAT('%', #{configKey}, '%')
AND config_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{configName}, '%')
AND is_status = #{isStatus}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_config (id, config_key, config_value, config_name, is_status, remark, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{configKey}, CAST(#{configValue} AS jsonb), #{configName}, #{isStatus}, #{remark}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_config SET config_key = #{configKey}, config_value = CAST(#{configValue} AS jsonb), config_name = #{configName}, is_status = #{isStatus}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
